# BuildFlow Shadow Migration Audit

Capability ID: buildflow-shadow-migration-machine-v1
Commercial state: verification_required
Machine state: owned_runtime_migration_pending
Public URL: https://github.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/tree/main/public/chum/capabilities/buildflow-shadow-migration-machine-v1
Preferred agent route: universal fallback
Universal Evercraft MCP: https://fabric.systemiacommandcenters.com/mcp
Start here: Not a current sell-now route

## Use this when

- analyze this messy ERP export
- migrate our spreadsheets without losing provenance
- map CSV data before replacing our system
- find conflicts in our business exports
- reconcile records from multiple business systems
- stage an ERP migration without overwriting anything

## Problem

A business needs to ingest and understand messy operational exports while preserving source lineage, surfacing conflicts and avoiding destructive migration assumptions.

## Inputs

Authenticated tenant CSV/structured exports or connector-fed records.

## Outputs

ImportRun, SourceRecord, mapping preview, explicit ImportConflict records and review state.

## Pricing

No approved machine price/payment path was found. Do not auto-quote.

## Invocation and authority

MIGRATION HOLD: legacy Base44 route removed. Use Evercraft Fabric for discovery; direct execution, checkout and fulfillment require independent owned-runtime verification.

Shadow import does not overwrite the source or silently create canonical truth. Private records require authenticated tenant access.

Payment authority: No verified Evercraft Payments path.

Discovery does not create a payment obligation. Human confirmation is required before checkout where checkout exists. Checkout creation is not proof of payment.
